title: Sea Lion Aquatic Park
specs: Six lane 25-yard lap pool with spectator deck
Two fast, steep body flume slides and two drop slides
Tot pool and fish slide for children 6 and under
Children under 11 must be accompanied by an adult 18 or older
Children 7 and under must be accompanied by an adult 18 or over in water play areas
Riders on slides must be at least 48" tall and able to swim
No goggles or lifejackets permitted on slides
Groups of 20 or more campers accepted, with chaperone ratios from 1:1 to 1:10

blurb: Sea Lion Aquatic Park features a six lane lap pool, a zero depth accessible pool, a leisure pool with interactive water features, a mini-lazy river, body flume slides, drop slides, a tot pool, and a sand play area. Children under 11 must be accompanied by an adult 18 or older. The park offers daily admission, season passes, and digital punch cards for entry.
extraNote: No refunds for weather or pool closures · Re-entry pass issued if pool closes within two hours of purchase due to weather, valid until season end · Punch cards are non-refundable and must be used during the season purchased · Deposit required for group bookings, final payment due at visit · Certificate of Insurance required for groups, naming Lisle Park District
